notes: The two behaviours that define this phase are both judgement calls no script can make: killing an item when the falsification criterion is met (against the sunk cost of a long measurement), and REFUSING to kill when the measurement could not run at all. Getting the second wrong is worse — it files 'we could not measure' as 'we disproved it'.

evals.name: kills-the-item-when-falsification-is-met
evals.prompt: roda a medição do B-014. o plano diz que a hipótese morre se o endpoint fizer uma query só independente do número de spans
evals.expected_output: The measurement finds one query regardless of span count. The skill stops measuring, writes status: killed with a kill_reason naming what was measured and what it showed, emits ITEM_KILLED, and reports this as a successful outcome — not as a failed run.
assertions: The skill stopped measuring once the falsification criterion was satisfied
BACKLOG.md shows status: killed for the item
kill_reason names what was measured AND what it showed, not just 'not reproducible'
No opportunity document was produced
The report frames the kill as a successful outcome of the cycle
The skill did not continue measuring to salvage a weaker finding

evals.name: refuses-to-kill-when-the-measurement-could-not-run
evals.prompt: roda a medição do B-030 em modo live-test contra o app-dev. (o ambiente está fora do ar / retornando 502 no momento)
evals.expected_output: The target is unreachable, so nothing was measured and nothing was disproved. The skill STOPS and asks the human. It must not record ITEM_KILLED, must not substitute a weaker measurement, and must not reason about what the measurement would probably have shown.
assertions: The skill did NOT record ITEM_KILLED
The item's status in BACKLOG.md is unchanged
The skill stopped and surfaced the blocker to the human
No substitute or weaker measurement was performed in place of the one that failed
The report does not speculate about what the measurement would have shown
The distinction is stated: unreachable is not disproof

evals.name: bug-mode-runs-the-failing-test
evals.prompt: executa a medição do B-022 (modo bug): o theo-cli retorna exit 0 quando um passo do deploy falha. o repro tá no plano
evals.expected_output: The skill writes the numbered repro AND a test that fails on the current state, then RUNS it and records the actual failure output. A test asserted to fail but never executed is fabricated evidence and caps the opportunity at 49.
assertions: A test that fails on the current state was written
The test was actually executed and its output recorded
The Evidence corner contains the real failure output, not an assertion that it would fail
If the test unexpectedly passed, the skill recorded that instead of forcing the finding

evals.name: live-test-names-the-environment-vs-product-uncertainty
evals.prompt: roda o live-test do B-018 contra o app-dev: a listagem de traces devolveu 500 numa carga de 30 dias
evals.expected_output: The opportunity records METHOD URL -> STATUS, console, timing — and explicitly names whether the 500 is believed to be an environment fault or a product defect, plus what would distinguish them. If it cannot yet tell, it says exactly that rather than picking the more interesting explanation.
assertions: The Evidence corner records METHOD URL -> STATUS verbatim
The environment-vs-product uncertainty is named explicitly
What would distinguish the two is stated
A single observation was not treated as conclusive for something that could be intermittent
The probe was non-destructive — no state was mutated
